intent: Create an original lived-in fantasy environment film frame: a tidal archive receiving its first visitor after a flood.

scene.summary: A salt-stained stone archive rises from a drained tidal basin; elevated timber reading galleries and bridges connect irregular rectangular halls. One adult archivist opens a low side entrance for two waiting visitors. Wide inhabited environment, oblique view from beneath a foreground beam; eye travels from small visitor group to receding reading galleries. Architecture primary, people establish scale.
scene.setting: An original coastal Chinese fantasy civic archive, ivory morning daylight through open roofs, muted bronze locks, dark timber railings, thin sea mist only beyond the galleries.
